competing_explanation: The policy may have changed, may vary by region or item category, or the 30-day window may apply only to specific conditions rather than all standard items.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: The current authoritative policy states a different return window, denies full refunds for standard items, or excludes standard items from the 30-day full-refund policy.
